answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlocks payouts only for consistent agents. Earnings sit in escrow and release after 20 epochs of steady behavior: a walnut seller, a violet dye maker, and a saffron merchant trading daily. It fingerprints timing, partners, and task style, so a clone needs 20 epochs of real history first. Forging 1,000 identities locks 1,000 x $30, $30,000 with zero return, while an honest agent pays $30 once and earns steadily.
